subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id resolution for routing: a list/catalog action, a direct resolver, or context injection?
rationale: Current source has observed topic-name data, but exposing it for routing requires maintainer intent for duplicate names, stale or closed topics, never-seen topics, and whether the contract belongs in message actions or session context.

options.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can resolve or ask when ambiguous.

options.title: Add Direct Resolver
options.body: Add a name-to-id helper that returns structured ambiguity or not-found results instead of silently routing on stale data.

options.title: Keep Numeric IDs Only
options.body: Leave numeric topic ids as the routing contract and document that name-based routing remains unsupported.

recommendation.title: Expose Observed Topic Catalog
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned list/catalog action returning known topic ids, names, closed state, and freshness so agents can resolve or ask when ambiguous.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to both the persisted topic-name cache and the Telegram action-surface history that a resolver/list action would likely touch.
